scientific_integrity: The certificate is an exhaustive rational quadtree inclusion/exclusion computation; no independent validation or stronger unrestricted extremality is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The optimizer classification is restricted to the two fixed antipodal root sites and to degrees at most six, plus the stated multiples-of-six obstruction. Cubic area comparisons are certified by rigorous rational enclosures, not closed-form integrals. The Pendyala manuscript was not fully accessible; unindexed equivalences remain possible.
title: Degree six is the first imbalance threshold for antipodal lemniscate area
